items.title: Stryker (SYK) Stock May Be 22% Undervalued On Manufacturing Issues
items.summary: Stryker has had a mixed few years on the market, and a series of headlines around manufacturing issues and shifting demand now puts the focus squarely on whether the current share price can be explained by the cash the business is expected to generate. With valuation work anchored on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view of those cash flows, the question is how well that intrinsic value estimate lines up with where the stock trades today.
